_readme: Site settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
name: Archive 88
description: Archive 88 makes a permanent collection of considered clothing: natural fibres, honest construction and fits that stay in the range season after season.
_shopify_domain_note: Set to your-store.myshopify.com and fill shopify_variant_ids in catalog.json to send the bag to Shopify checkout.

categories.title: Outerwear
categories.intro: Coats and jackets in wool, wax and gabardine. Built for weather, cut for years.
seo: Archive 88 outerwear is cut for British weather and made to last for years: overcoats and car coats in virgin wool, waxed field jackets and Harringtons in British cotton, and a quilted liner that layers under all of them.

Every coat is kept in the range season after season, so the one you buy this winter is the one we'll still make next year. Not sure of your size? Our {size guide} lists chest and length for every style, and returns are free for 30 days.

categories.title: Knitwear
categories.intro: Merino, lambswool and cashmere from mills that have spun for generations.
seo: Knitwear in merino, lambswool, Shetland wool and Mongolian cashmere, from mills that have spun for generations. Crew necks, cardigans, roll necks and polos, in colours that sit with everything else in the collection.
Wash wool cold and dry it flat and it will soften with every wear. See the {size guide} for chest measurements, or pair a crew with {trousers}.

categories.title: Shirts
categories.intro: Oxford, poplin, flannel and linen. The shirts you reach for first.
seo: Shirts in Oxford cloth, poplin, flannel, linen and seersucker: the shirts you reach for first. Overshirts in moleskin, wool and heavy twill double as a light jacket.
Every shirt is cut in a relaxed or regular fit and finished with strong seams and real buttons. Find your size in the {size guide}.

categories.title: Trousers
categories.intro: Chinos, wool trousers and selvedge denim, sized by the waist.
seo: Trousers sized by the waist in inches: chinos, selvedge jeans, wool trousers and workwear cuts in drill and canvas. Every waist comes with a 32 inch inside leg, finished so it can be taken up.
Fits run from straight to relaxed and tapered. Choose a fit from the links above, or check the {size guide} for waist and hip measurements.

categories.title: Jersey
categories.intro: Heavyweight tees and loopback sweats in organic cotton.
seo: Heavyweight T-shirts, loopback sweatshirts and rugby shirts in organic cotton, knitted and garment-dyed so they hold their shape wash after wash.
Boxy and regular fits, in colours that stay in the range. Pair a sweatshirt with {trousers} or layer a tee under {knitwear}.

categories.title: Tailoring
categories.intro: Soft-shouldered jackets that dress up or down without trying.
seo: Soft-shouldered tailoring that dresses up or down without trying: blazers in wool hopsack and cashmere blends, sport coats in tweed and corduroy, and suit jackets in flannel, linen and mohair.
Jackets are half lined or unlined so they wear like a cardigan. Find your chest size in the {size guide}.

gift_cards._note: SAMPLE terms: check validity period and wording against your policy before launch. shopify_variant_ids: {"email/100": 123, "post/100": 456} enables checkout handoff.
gift_cards.post_note: Printed on heavy card in a woven envelope. Free UK postage, dispatched in 1 to 2 working days.
gift_cards.email_note: Arrives in their inbox straight away, or on a date you choose.
gift_cards.terms: Spend online across the whole collection. Use it in one go or over several orders.

social._note: PLACEHOLDER handles. Replace with the real profiles.

business._note: PLACEHOLDER details, safe to publish while testing: the phone number is from Ofcom's range reserved for TV and film (020 7946 0xxx), the email uses the reserved .example domain, and the address, company and VAT numbers are fictional. Replace all of them before launch: UK distance-selling rules require your real trading name, a geographic address and a way to contact you.

shipping_text: Dispatched within 1 to 2 working days, tracked. UK delivery 1 to 3 working days: free on orders over £150, otherwise £5. International rates are shown at checkout.
_shipping_text_note: PLACEHOLDER wording. Replace with your real rates and times.
_legal_reviewed_note: Set to true once a solicitor has checked Privacy and Terms; it removes the 'Draft' note on those pages.
_page_size_note: Products per listing page. Pages are numbered with ?page=2 and so on.
_categories_note: subcategories: a style joins the first group whose match words appear in its title; the group with no match words takes the rest. seo: paragraphs under the grid; {size guide}, {trousers}, {knitwear} and other category names become links.
_trending_note: Shown on the search page before the shopper types.
